description: Order an animated pixel sprite item, for example a potion or a key, from a preset or the user's own description, in parts that play one after another: 10 Gold for the first part and 8 for each more part. It can be drawn in an element's colours, or from one of the user's own still pictures (reference_image_id). First call chargen_quote_sprite_item, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for each part's animated GIF. A part that fails is refunded. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

custom_parts.description: Parts in the user's own words.

plays.description: LOOP (the default) repeats, ONCE plays one time, HOLD plays and stops on its last frame.

text.description: What the part shows, in the user's own words.

description.description: The item in the user's own words, in place of preset.

element.description: Optional element or colour that every part is drawn in.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

parts.description: The parts to draw, by key, each one at most once. With a preset, its own parts (gem: SPINS, SHINES, COLLECTED; heart: BEATS, POPS, COLLECTED; healthpotion: BUBBLES, DRUNK, HEALS; manapotion: SWIRLS, DRUNK, GLOWS; coin: SPINS, FLIPS, SHINES; chest: SHINES, RATTLES, OPENS; sword: GLOWS, FLARES, DIMS; ring: TURNS, FLARES, RESTS; scroll: UNROLLS, GLOWS, BURNS; crystalball: MIST, VISION, CLEARS; torch: LIGHTS, FLICKERS, GOES_OUT; key: FLOATS, TURNS, GLOWS). With a description: IDLE, USED, GONE. parts and custom_parts together hold 1 to 10 parts.

preset.description: One of CharGen's items. Give preset or description, not both.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_sprite_item. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

reference_image_id.description: Optional UUID of one of the user's own still pictures, from chargen_search_gallery. The item is drawn from it.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

name: chargen_generate_sprite_item
title: Order sprite item
